title: greet.sh should support a --shout flag
body:
## Problem

There is no way to get the greeting in upper case, which the demo script wants
for its banner line.

## What to do

Accept `--shout` before the name. With it, print the greeting upper-cased:
`./greet.sh --shout World` prints `HELLO, WORLD!`. Without it, behaviour is
unchanged.

## Done when

- `./greet.sh --shout World` prints `HELLO, WORLD!` and exits 0.
- `./greet.sh World` still prints `Hello, World!`.
- `./test.sh` passes, covering both.
